decisions.reason: The firm visibly invested in the charting bundle, with its own page, a public launch announcement and four rapid releases, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it as part of the map.apps line.
The hierarchical search bundle was only mentioned on the website, so commitment is modest, but as a low-cost plugin inside the core map.apps ecosystem it is likely retained.
VueTOC was announced on the home page as a new approach to mobile map control, and that public framing, plus its fit with the firm's mobile direction, encourages persistence.
The GIS solution platform is central to the firm's strategic direction and represents heavy sunk investment, so dropping it is very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture has its own dedicated page and matches the firm's announced mobile GIS strategy, so management will attribute any weak results to temporary causes.
The search extension has its own page, which signals visible commitment, and it complements the core web map apps, so it is likely kept.
